responsibility: Implements builtin #[derive(Copy)] expansion for the Rust front end. This file generates the minimal marker-trait implementation impl Copy for <type> {} for structs, tuple structs, enums, and unions, using the derive visitor framework to return a synthesized TraitImpl AST item that macro expansion inserts adjacent to the original type definition.
same_name_distinction: Implements the Copy-specific derive expander, generating the marker-trait impl for supported item kinds. Unlike the paired header, this .cc contains the concrete synthesis of impl Copy blocks rather than the DeriveCopy class declaration and method signatures.
